description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 获取镜像已共享的阿里云账号列表

descriptions.zh: 调用[ModifyImagePermission](~~436982~~)可将镜像共享给无影的其他用户或者取消已经共享的镜像。调用本接口可获取当前镜像已共享的阿里云账号列表。
descriptions.en: You can call the [ModifyImagePermission](~~436982~~) operation to share an image with another cloud computer user or unshare an image. You can call the DescribeImagePermission operation to obtain the Alibaba Cloud accounts with which the current image is shared.
